resources.string: The European PC DVD, as an .iso. It is unpacked on this device; nothing is uploaded.
The English v1.0.1 executable, bare or in a .zip. It is checked against the build this port was made from.

The game is read from plain files, so everything it needs must end up in real storage. The picker above already does that without any permission. Allowing all files access only adds two shortcuts: using an unpacked game folder where it lies, and installing to a folder of your choice. It grants access to the whole shared storage, so it is optional.
All files access not granted. Optional: the picker works without it.
All files access not granted. Tap to review the setting.
In the system screen, allow this app to manage all files, then come back. This screen checks again when you return.
This device has no All Files Access screen. Use the picker instead.
All files access needs Android 11 or newer. Use the picker instead.
This device has no folder picker. Use the disc image instead.
%1$s does not look like an unpacked Virtua Tennis 3 folder: it has no Resource folder.
Reading the game from %1$s. It is used where it lies: nothing is copied.
%1$s can be read but not written. The game keeps its settings and saves there, so it is copied into app storage instead.
%1$s cannot be read any more (a removed card, or a deleted folder). Pick the game folder again.
%1$s holds more than one folder with a Resource folder (%2$s). Pick the one that is the game data folder.
%1$s cannot be read. Pick the folder again.
Reading a folder outside app storage needs all files access. Grant it above, or copy the game in with the picker.
Folder chosen. Its files are copied into app storage while installing.
%1$s cannot be written, so its files are copied into app storage while installing.
That folder has no Resource folder, so it is not an unpacked Virtua Tennis 3 install. Pick the folder that holds Resource, or the folder that contains it.
That folder holds more than one folder with a Resource folder (%1$s). Pick the game data folder itself.

The installed game data cannot be read any more. Set it up again here: nothing else on this device was deleted.

Cannot clear the partial install at %1$s. Remove it, then try again.
Install cancelled. The partial copy was removed, and your own game folder was not touched.
An unpacked game folder needs no extra space. Unpacking the disc image needs about 4.5 GB.
Requires your own copy of Virtua Tennis 3. Unofficial fan port, not affiliated with SEGA.
A preset only fills in defaults: each option above can be changed on its own. Auto follows the device tier and the thermal status. The game\'s own graphics options are untouched.
Resolution and frame rate are set when the renderer starts, so this relaunches the game. Press Back to close without applying.
Go back to setup? The game data stays on this device; the next install can read a different folder or unpack the disc image again.

The game and this screen write one log on this device: startup, the game engine, the installer, storage, Vulkan, frame times, audio, input and the Android lifecycle. Nothing is uploaded. A report is a plain .txt file you can read, save or share.
Detailed logging (adds debug detail; turn off when done)

Version %1$s
Log size %2$s (%3$s entries, %4$s dropped)
Last report %5$s
Last error: %6$s

The report contains the app version, device model and Android version, the install state, graphics and frame statistics, audio diagnostics, lifecycle events and the error history. It never contains file contents, account details or a location. Clearing logs removes only the log files and crash records, never the game.
This device has no document picker, so the report cannot be saved.

Delete the log files, the last-error record and crash records on this device? The game and its data are not touched.
